code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # Full-length non-background lines mark compartment boundaries.
    row_cuts = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    col_cuts = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    rb = [-1] + row_cuts + [h]
    cb = [-1] + col_cuts + [w]
    regions = [(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1], cb[j]+1, cb[j+1])
               for i in range(len(rb)-1) for j in range(len(cb)-1)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Select the compartment containing the most non-background cells as the motif.
    source = max(regions, key=lambda q: sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(q[0],q[1]) for c in range(q[2],q[3])))
    motif = [row[source[2]:source[3]] for row in grid[source[0]:source[1]]]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in regions:
        if (r1-r0,c1-c0) != (source[1]-source[0],source[3]-source[2]):
            continue
        for dr in range(r1-r0):
            for dc in range(c1-c0):
                out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = motif[dr][dc]
    return out
'''
